fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (LLY) expands tumor research platform through acquisition of Calytrix Bio and precision oncology collaboration with Stipple Bio, with fair value assessment of $1,463.
fields.summary_ko.1: LLY builds next-generation growth drivers through high-value pharmaceutical development in oncology and neuroscience, based on its GLP-1 cardio-metabolic disease revenue engine.
